title: Cowaltz
blurb: A knight, a fairy princess and a trooper defend a little blue moon from diving bees. Knock bees into each other for ricochet chains. Get stung and you swell up until a teammate runs over with an EpiPen.
controls: Stick to move (light push tiptoes, full push runs); Knight: BASH; Fairy: hold SHOOT; Trooper: hold FIRE; tap a hero or their portrait to switch, the others are AI
